key.name: ram-format
key.description: How the RAM metric is rendered in the panel.

key.name: vram-format
key.description: How the VRAM metric is rendered in the panel.

key.name: metric-order
key.description: Whether VRAM or RAM is shown first in the panel.

key.name: decimals
key.description: Number of decimal places used when formatting GiB values.

key.name: unit-placement
key.description: Whether the GiB unit is shown after the numeric value.

key.name: separator
key.description: Text placed between the VRAM and RAM metrics in the panel.

key.name: show-ram
key.description: Whether the RAM metric is visible in the panel.

key.name: show-vram
key.description: Whether the VRAM metric is visible in the panel.

key.name: show-icons
key.description: Whether RAM and VRAM icons are shown in the panel.

key.name: menu-show-ram
key.description: Whether the RAM section appears in the dropdown menu.

key.name: menu-show-vram
key.description: Whether the VRAM section appears in the dropdown menu.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often the metrics are refreshed, in seconds. Supported values are 1, 2, 5, 10, 15, 30 and 60.

key.name: panel-box
key.description: Which panel box the indicator is placed in.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Index within the selected panel box.

key.name: selected-gpu
key.description: GPU whose VRAM is displayed: 'auto', 'all', or a stable PCI device identity.

key.name: ram-alert-enabled
key.description: Enable RAM usage threshold alerts.

key.name: ram-warning
key.description: RAM usage percentage that triggers a warning.

key.name: ram-critical
key.description: RAM usage percentage that triggers a critical alert.

key.name: vram-alert-enabled
key.description: Enable VRAM usage threshold alerts.

key.name: vram-warning
key.description: VRAM usage percentage that triggers a warning.

key.name: vram-critical
key.description: VRAM usage percentage that triggers a critical alert.

key.name: alert-cooldown
key.description: Minimum seconds between repeated notifications for the same metric.

key.name: alert-hysteresis
key.description: Percentage points below a threshold required to clear an alert, preventing flapping.

key.name: enable-colors
key.description: Color the indicator for warning and critical states.

key.name: color-target
key.description: Which part of each metric changes color: the whole metric, its icon, its numeric value, or its percentage.

key.name: show-normal-color
key.description: Color the indicator green when no alert is active.
